rulebook.title: The Bureaucrat
rulebook.addWhen: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.addWhenTable: Liberals are too often fooled about which policies were discarded.
rulebook.pitch: Looks at the top two discarded policies once, to catch a lying President or Chancellor.

details.label: Goal
text: You belong to the party on your membership card, which the group chooses at setup, and you win when that party wins.

details.label: What you know
text: What that party knows: you open your eyes with it at setup. As a Liberal you learn nothing.

details.label: Power
text: Once per game, you may reveal your Secret Role card and look at the top two policies of the discard pile. You may tell the table what you saw, or lie about it.

details.label: Danger
text: The price: once you have used the power, you can never be nominated Chancellor again. Revealing shows your role but never your party.

details.label: How to play it
text: Look right after a government you doubt, while its discards are still on top of the pile.
